<xsl:stylesheet version="2.0" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform" xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns:fn="http://www.w3.org/2005/xpath-functions" exclude-result-prefixes="xs fn">
	<xsl:output method="xml" encoding="UTF-8" byte-order-mark="no" indent="yes"/>
	<xsl:template match="/">
		<flowBundles>
			<xsl:for-each select="Aggregated/flowBundleReport">
				<xsl:variable name="var1_tenantFlows" as="node()" select="tenantFlows"/>
				<xsl:variable name="var2_timestampLocation" as="node()" select="timestampLocation"/>
				<flowBundle>
					<timestamp>
						<xsl:sequence select="fn:string($var2_timestampLocation/timestamp)"/>
					</timestamp>
					<instance>
						<xsl:sequence select="fn:string($var2_timestampLocation/instance)"/>
					</instance>
					<environment>
						<xsl:sequence select="fn:string($var2_timestampLocation/environment)"/>
					</environment>
					<tenant>
						<xsl:sequence select="fn:string($var1_tenantFlows/tenant)"/>
					</tenant>
					<name>
						<xsl:sequence select="fn:string($var1_tenantFlows/name)"/>
					</name>
					<flowid>
						<xsl:sequence select="fn:string($var1_tenantFlows/id)"/>
					</flowid>
					<uptime>
						<xsl:sequence select="fn:string($var1_tenantFlows/uptime)"/>
					</uptime>
					<status>
						<xsl:sequence select="fn:string($var1_tenantFlows/status)"/>
					</status>
					<version>
						<xsl:sequence select="xs:string(xs:integer(fn:string($var1_tenantFlows/version)))"/>
					</version>
					<tracingTtl>
						<xsl:sequence select="xs:string(xs:integer(fn:string($var1_tenantFlows/tracingTtl)))"/>
					</tracingTtl>
					<timeout>
						<xsl:sequence select="xs:string(xs:integer(fn:string($var1_tenantFlows/timeout)))"/>
					</timeout>
					<completedExchanges>
						<xsl:sequence select="xs:string(xs:integer(fn:string($var1_tenantFlows/completedExchanges)))"/>
					</completedExchanges>
					<lastCompletedExchange>
						<xsl:sequence select="fn:string($var1_tenantFlows/lastCompletedExchange)"/>
					</lastCompletedExchange>
					<pendingExchanges>
						<xsl:sequence select="xs:string(xs:integer(fn:string($var1_tenantFlows/pendingExchanges)))"/>
					</pendingExchanges>
					<failedExchanges>
						<xsl:sequence select="xs:string(xs:integer(fn:string($var1_tenantFlows/failedExchanges)))"/>
					</failedExchanges>
					<lastFailedExchange>
						<xsl:sequence select="fn:string($var1_tenantFlows/lastFailedExchange)"/>
					</lastFailedExchange>
				</flowBundle>
			</xsl:for-each>
		</flowBundles>
	</xsl:template>
</xsl:stylesheet>

resource.content:
<xsl:stylesheet xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform" version="1.0">
    <xsl:output method="text" encoding="UTF-8" indent="yes"/>
    <xsl:template match="/">
        <xsl:text>INSERT INTO FLOWBUNDLE_REPORT (timestamp,INSTANCE,ENVIRONMENT,TENANT,NAME,FLOWID,UPTIME,STATUS,VERSION,TRACINGTTL,TIMEOUT,COMPLETEDEXCHANGES,LASTCOMPLETEDEXCHANGE,PENDINGEXCHANGES,FAILEDEXCHANGES,LASTFAILEDEXCHANGE)
VALUES </xsl:text>
        <xsl:for-each select="/flowBundles/flowBundle">
                    <xsl:text>(</xsl:text>
                    <xsl:for-each select="timestamp | instance | environment | tenant | name | flowid | uptime | status | version | tracingTtl | timeout | completedExchanges | lastCompletedExchange | pendingExchanges | failedExchanges | lastFailedExchange">
                        <xsl:text>'</xsl:text>
                        <xsl:value-of select="normalize-space(.)"/>
                        <xsl:text>'</xsl:text>
                        <xsl:if test="position() != last()">
                            <xsl:text>,</xsl:text>
                        </xsl:if>
                    </xsl:for-each>
                    <xsl:text>)</xsl:text>
                    <xsl:if test="position() != last()">
                        <xsl:text>, </xsl:text>
                    </xsl:if>
            </xsl:for-each>
        <xsl:text>;</xsl:text>
    </xsl:template>
</xsl:stylesheet>
